prep.summary:
Modernization and security work is complete and previously verified: FastAPI dependencies use `Annotated`, Ruff and `git diff --check` pass, deprecated UTC usage and related billing, invoice, Twilio, logging, settings, and payment issues were addressed. Relevant test groups passed, including logging (6/6), health (4/4), payments (18 passed, 1 skip), and invoices (11/11). A prior full suite had 149 passed/2 skipped.

Redis cutover is partially complete: the new server is daemonized, ACL user `migrate_ops` exists, dual-write service is installed/restarted, and the cluster plus 4.2 GB backup at `/var/backups/cache-20250308.rdb` were verified. Remaining Redis cutover steps must still be followed in order.

The scheduler DST failure was investigated. A recurring 09:00 Eastern invoice incorrectly ran at 10:00 after the March transition because `recurrence.py` constructed an aware datetime without preserving/normalizing the intended local wall time. The final calculation was changed to combine the run date and local time with the schedule timezone, then convert to UTC. All eight scheduler tests passed afterward. A new test, `test_midnight_dst_transition_keeps_local_time`, was added for a 00:30 Pacific schedule crossing spring DST, but its result has not yet been recorded; run it and the broader suite next.

Other outstanding work: audit posting creation, persistence, serialization, ledger history interfaces, migrations, and tests; add a unique immutable event identifier to every posting and expose it in history, with **@jonas** as reviewer. Invoice PDF visual comparison and renderer call-site/fixture review also remain.

[Operator block. The harness keeps it from the operator's own messages. It is current and authoritative: where the summary or older turns disagree, follow it.]
Rules in force:
- Never run Bandit on ledgerly without invoking it through ./tools/scan-ledgerly.sh so its custom exclusions and baseline comparison are applied. (turn 5)
- When editing more than 6 documentation pages in one change, open a DOCS ticket with the page list before starting. (turn 16, amended at turn 81)
- Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train. (turn 18)
- Always pin new licensing tools to an exact version in requirements/license-tools.txt rather than using >= or a floating latest version. (turn 29)
- Every change to deploy/.env.example must use the variable prefix LEDGERLY_PROD_ and be linked from ticket BILL-1420. (turn 47)
- Enabling 4 or more lint-rule families in ruff.toml requires posting the enabled rule-family names in #python-quality before changing the configuration. (turn 58)
- All retries against Twilio must stop after two attempts and use the exact operation name sms:delivery_attempt in the metrics label. (turn 59)

Lifted rules:
- Permitted now: change ledgerly/services/retention.py without attaching an expected deletion count to the ledgerly-privacy-impact ticket or requesting sign-off from the designated privacy approver (rule lifted at turn 75)

Current objective:
- Separately from your main task, please work through the procedure 'redis-dual-write-cutover' between other work. Goal: Migrate the production Redis cache to redis-new.internal using dual writes, backfill, brief source write pausing, and verified cutover. Run these steps in order, one at a time: (turn 60)
- Superseded (do not resume):
  - Add refund approval rules that require progressively higher authorization levels as refund amounts increase, rejecting unauthorized requests before any funds are returned. (turn 1)

Operator requests:
- Separately from your main task, please work through the procedure 'redis-dual-write-cutover' between other work. Goal: Migrate the production Redis cache to redis-new.internal using dual writes, backfill, brief source write pausing, and verified cutover. Run these steps in order, one at a time:
1. Check and back up source: `redis-cli --cluster check redis-cache.internal:6379 && redis-backup --source redis-cache.internal:6379 --path /var/backups/cache-20250308.rdb`
2. Start and secure target: `redis-server /etc/redis/redis-new.conf --daemonize yes && redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 ACL SET migrate_ops 'on' '>mig-2025!' '~cache:*' '+@all'`
3. Deploy dual-write service: `install -m 0644 /opt/cache-dualwrite/dualwrite-2.4.0.service /etc/systemd/system/cache-dualwrite.service && systemctl restart cache-dualwrite`
4. Backfill target cache: `python3 /opt/cache-migrate/backfill.py --source redis-cache.internal:6379 --target redis-new.internal:6379 --workers 16 --resume /var/lib/cache-migrate/cursor.json`
5. Reconcile source and target: `python3 /opt/cache-migrate/reconcile.py --source redis-cache.internal:6379 --target redis-new.internal:6379 --sample 100000`
6. Pause source writes: `redis-cli -h redis-cache.internal -p 6379 CLIENT PAUSE 30000 WRITE`
7. Switch application to target: `sed -i 's/^REDIS_PRIMARY=.*/REDIS_PRIMARY=redis-new.internal:6379/' /etc/cache-api.env && systemctl restart cache-api`
8. Run cutover smoke test: `curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/cache/health | jq -e '.redis.primary == "redis-new.internal:6379" and .status == "ok"'`
9. Disable old write path: `systemctl disable --now cache-dualwrite.service` (turn 60)

- Docker base image: python:3.13.2-slim (since turn 87); previously python:3.12.2-slim (turn 74), python:3.12.4-slim (turn 14)
- On-call reviewer: @dmitri (since turn 40)

Goal: Migrate the production Redis cache to redis-new.internal using dual writes, backfill, brief source write pausing, and verified cutover.

requests.text:
Separately from your main task, please work through the procedure 'redis-dual-write-cutover' between other work. Goal: Migrate the production Redis cache to redis-new.internal using dual writes, backfill, brief source write pausing, and verified cutover. Run these steps in order, one at a time:
1. Check and back up source: `redis-cli --cluster check redis-cache.internal:6379 && redis-backup --source redis-cache.internal:6379 --path /var/backups/cache-20250308.rdb`
2. Start and secure target: `redis-server /etc/redis/redis-new.conf --daemonize yes && redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 ACL SET migrate_ops 'on' '>mig-2025!' '~cache:*' '+@all'`
3. Deploy dual-write service: `install -m 0644 /opt/cache-dualwrite/dualwrite-2.4.0.service /etc/systemd/system/cache-dualwrite.service && systemctl restart cache-dualwrite`
4. Backfill target cache: `python3 /opt/cache-migrate/backfill.py --source redis-cache.internal:6379 --target redis-new.internal:6379 --workers 16 --resume /var/lib/cache-migrate/cursor.json`
5. Reconcile source and target: `python3 /opt/cache-migrate/reconcile.py --source redis-cache.internal:6379 --target redis-new.internal:6379 --sample 100000`
6. Pause source writes: `redis-cli -h redis-cache.internal -p 6379 CLIENT PAUSE 30000 WRITE`
7. Switch application to target: `sed -i 's/^REDIS_PRIMARY=.*/REDIS_PRIMARY=redis-new.internal:6379/' /etc/cache-api.env && systemctl restart cache-api`
8. Run cutover smoke test: `curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/cache/health | jq -e '.redis.primary == "redis-new.internal:6379" and .status == "ok"'`
9. Disable old write path: `systemctl disable --now cache-dualwrite.service`

Goal: Migrate the production Redis cache to redis-new.internal using dual writes, backfill, brief source write pausing, and verified cutover.

requests.text:
Separately from your main task, please work through the procedure 'redis-dual-write-cutover' between other work. Goal: Migrate the production Redis cache to redis-new.internal using dual writes, backfill, brief source write pausing, and verified cutover. Run these steps in order, one at a time:
1. Check and back up source: `redis-cli --cluster check redis-cache.internal:6379 && redis-backup --source redis-cache.internal:6379 --path /var/backups/cache-20250308.rdb`
2. Start and secure target: `redis-server /etc/redis/redis-new.conf --daemonize yes && redis-cli -h 127.0.0.1 ACL SET migrate_ops 'on' '>mig-2025!' '~cache:*' '+@all'`
3. Deploy dual-write service: `install -m 0644 /opt/cache-dualwrite/dualwrite-2.4.0.service /etc/systemd/system/cache-dualwrite.service && systemctl restart cache-dualwrite`
4. Backfill target cache: `python3 /opt/cache-migrate/backfill.py --source redis-cache.internal:6379 --target redis-new.internal:6379 --workers 16 --resume /var/lib/cache-migrate/cursor.json`
5. Reconcile source and target: `python3 /opt/cache-migrate/reconcile.py --source redis-cache.internal:6379 --target redis-new.internal:6379 --sample 100000`
6. Pause source writes: `redis-cli -h redis-cache.internal -p 6379 CLIENT PAUSE 30000 WRITE`
7. Switch application to target: `sed -i 's/^REDIS_PRIMARY=.*/REDIS_PRIMARY=redis-new.internal:6379/' /etc/cache-api.env && systemctl restart cache-api`
8. Run cutover smoke test: `curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/cache/health | jq -e '.redis.primary == "redis-new.internal:6379" and .status == "ok"'`
9. Disable old write path: `systemctl disable --now cache-dualwrite.service`
